string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: Setup host for Uyghur ULY keyboard

string.name: host_subtitle
string.value: Offline Uyghur Latin keyboard for HarmonyOS NEXT. Suggestions stay on your device.

string.name: host_enable
string.value: Enable the input method in System settings → Keyboard & input method, then switch to Uyghur ULY keyboard while typing.

string.name: host_privacy
string.value: Typing stays on device. Open source on GitHub.
